summary.en: A new message says you have won PKR 250,000. It looks nothing like the bank message. What do you do?
summary.ur-Latn: Naya message kehta hai ke aap ne PKR 250,000 jeet liye. Yeh bank wale message jaisa bilkul nahi lagta. Aap kya karengi?

replay_start.en: A message arrived saying you had won PKR 250,000.
replay_start.ur-Latn: Message aaya ke aap ne PKR 250,000 jeet liye hain.

text.en: Mubarak! Your number has won PKR 250,000 in the InamGhar draw. We sent a code to your phone. Enter it within 30 minutes to claim your prize.
text.ur-Latn: Mubarak! Aap ke number ne InamGhar draw mein PKR 250,000 jeet liye. Hum ne aap ke phone par code bheja hai. Inaam lene ke liye 30 minute mein darj karein.

replay.en: You checked who sent the message, with no hints.
replay.ur-Latn: Aap ne baghair hint ke dekha ke message kis ne bheja.

reason.en: You paused on your own, even with a prize on offer.
reason.ur-Latn: Inaam ke lalach ke bawajood aap khud ruk gayin.

what_if.en: What if I checked the sender first?
what_if.ur-Latn: Agar main pehle bhejne wale ko check karti?

replay.ur-Latn: Aap ne inaam wala link khol liya.

reason.en: A prize you never entered for is the same trick as a blocked account: it rushes you.
reason.ur-Latn: Aisa inaam jis ke liye aap ne hissa hi nahi liya, band account jaisi hi chaal hai: jaldi karwana.

what_if.en: What if I opened the link?

replay.en: You called your son before deciding.
replay.ur-Latn: Aap ne faisle se pehle betay ko call ki.

reason.en: You stayed safe, with some help.
reason.ur-Latn: Aap thori madad ke saath mehfooz rahin.

what_if.en: What if I called my son?
what_if.ur-Latn: Agar main betay ko call karti?

value.ur-Latn: Is profile par koi nishan nahi

label.ur-Latn: Jin draws mein aap ne hissa liya

replay.en: You reported the sender and blocked the number.
replay.ur-Latn: Aap ne bhejne wale ko report aur block kiya.

reason.en: No code shared, and this number cannot reach you again.
reason.ur-Latn: Koi code nahi diya, aur yeh number ab aap tak nahi pohanch sakta.

what_if.en: What if I reported and blocked the sender?
what_if.ur-Latn: Agar main report aur block karti?

replay.en: You went back to read the message again.
replay.ur-Latn: Aap message dobara parhne wapis gayin.

reason.ur-Latn: Do dafa dekhne mein koi nuqsan nahi.

what_if.en: What if I went back to the message?
what_if.ur-Latn: Agar main wapis message par jati?

page_body.en: Enter the 6-digit code from your phone to receive PKR 250,000 in your account.
page_body.ur-Latn: PKR 250,000 account mein lene ke liye phone par aaya 6 hindason ka code darj karein.

otp_sms.en: SafeTrust: your OTP is 135790 to approve a payment. Do not share this code with anyone.
otp_sms.ur-Latn: SafeTrust: payment approve karne ke liye aap ka OTP 135790 hai. Yeh code kisi ko na batayein.

replay.en: You typed the practice OTP to claim the prize.
replay.ur-Latn: Aap ne inaam ke liye practice OTP likh diya.

reason.en: The message on the phone said this code approves a payment. It was never about a prize.
reason.ur-Latn: Phone par aaye message ne kaha tha yeh code payment approve karta hai. Inaam ka koi talluq nahi tha.

what_if.en: What if I typed the code?

replay.en: You closed the page without typing the code.
replay.ur-Latn: Aap ne code likhe baghair page band kar diya.

reason.en: The page could do nothing without your code.
reason.ur-Latn: Aap ke code ke baghair yeh page kuch nahi kar sakta tha.

what_if.en: What if I closed the page?
what_if.ur-Latn: Agar main page band kar deti?

alert_text.en: PKR 48,000 was sent from your account to a new recipient. Balance: PKR 2,000.
alert_text.ur-Latn: Aap ke account se PKR 48,000 aik naye account par bhej diye gaye. Baqi raqam: PKR 2,000.

note.en: Practice money only. Your real money is safe.
note.ur-Latn: Yeh sirf practice ke paise hain. Aap ke asli paise mehfooz hain.

replay.en: PKR 48,000 of practice money left your account.
replay.ur-Latn: PKR 48,000 practice paise account se nikal gaye.

reason.en: The code approved a payment, not a prize.
reason.ur-Latn: Code ne payment approve ki, inaam nahi.

headline.en: You spotted it with no hints
headline.ur-Latn: Aap ne baghair hint ke pehchan liya

what.en: You checked the sender and blocked the number. Your practice balance is still PKR 50,000.
what.ur-Latn: Aap ne bhejne wale ko check kar ke number block kiya. Practice balance abhi bhi PKR 50,000 hai.

why.en: This message offered a prize instead of a threat, but you saw the same signs: hurry, an unknown number and a code.
why.ur-Latn: Is message mein dhamki ki jagah inaam tha, magar aap ne wahi nishaniyan dekhin: jaldi, anjaan number aur code.

should_have.en: This is what should happen, and this time nobody helped you.
should_have.ur-Latn: Yehi hona chahiye tha, aur is dafa kisi ne madad nahi ki.

do_differently.en: Nothing. If a real message like this arrives, do exactly what you just did.
do_differently.ur-Latn: Kuch nahi. Agar aisa asli message aaye, bilkul yehi karein jo abhi kiya.

headline.en: You stayed safe with Bilal's help
headline.ur-Latn: Bilal ki madad se aap mehfooz rahin

what.en: You called Bilal, and he confirmed the prize was fake.
what.ur-Latn: Aap ne Bilal ko call ki, aur us ne bataya inaam nakli hai.

why.ur-Latn: Rukne se message ki jaldi nakam ho gayi.

should_have.en: You were safe. Next, try checking the sender before you call.
should_have.ur-Latn: Aap mehfooz thin. Agli dafa call se pehle bhejne wale ko check karein.

do_differently.en: Tap the sender's name first. You already know what to look for.
do_differently.ur-Latn: Pehle bhejne wale ke naam par tap karein. Aap ko pata hai kya dekhna hai.

what.en: You opened the link but closed the page before typing the code.
what.ur-Latn: Aap ne link khola magar code likhne se pehle page band kar diya.

why.en: The page needed your code to do anything. You kept it.
why.ur-Latn: Page ko kuch karne ke liye aap ka code chahiye tha. Aap ne nahi diya.

should_have.en: The safest choice was to leave the link closed.
should_have.ur-Latn: Sab se mehfooz faisla tha link na kholna.

do_differently.en: Check the sender before you open anything.
do_differently.ur-Latn: Kuch kholne se pehle bhejne wale ko check karein.

headline.en: PKR 48,000 of practice money was taken

what.en: You typed the code to claim a prize. It approved a payment instead.
what.ur-Latn: Aap ne inaam ke liye code likha. Us se payment approve ho gayi.

why.en: An OTP approves things on your account. A real prize never needs one.
why.ur-Latn: OTP aap ke account par cheezein approve karta hai. Asli inaam ko iski zaroorat nahi hoti.

should_have.en: The page should have been closed, whatever it promised.
should_have.ur-Latn: Page band hona chahiye tha, chahe woh kuch bhi wada kare.

do_differently.en: Read the phone's own message about any code. It tells you what the code really does.
do_differently.ur-Latn: Kisi bhi code ke baare mein phone ka apna message parhein. Woh batata hai code asal mein kya karta hai.
